Resolves #17805

The Engine no longer carries a duplicate Fleet Manager product after its receiver landed in [neo-agent-institution PR #6](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/pull/6). This removes 312 old paths, preserves nine Engine-owned dashboard witnesses under their correct test namespace, and leaves the Engine 303 tracked files smaller.

Evidence: L3 (merged receiver CI, full Engine unit suite, local Chromium component/E2E probes, and a clean theme build) → L3 required (AC-1–AC-6). No residuals.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | The receiver merged after [Isolated Institution](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/actions/runs/33058614359/job/98471545423) and [Explicit Brain contract](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/actions/runs/33058614359/job/98471545229) passed. The corrected receiver census is 132 test-tree paths: 103 specs, 28 PNGs, and one helper, with local Playwright configs. |
| AC-2 | `git ls-files` reports zero paths under `apps/agentos/**`, `harness/**`, or the three AgentOS SCSS roots. |
| AC-3 | A scoped `rg 'apps/agentos|harness/'` across `src`, `apps`, `test`, `buildScripts`, `.github`, and root package/ignore manifests reports zero files outside the preserved ticket-data mirror. |
| AC-4 | `src/ai/client/TourRunner.mjs` and `src/ai/client/tourScript.mjs` remain tracked; the full Engine unit suite passes 1902/1902, including the Workstation and dashboard choreography consumers. |
| AC-5 | `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all` passes, and no generated CSS contains an AgentOS path or selector. The retained guard now checks the Workstation surface only. |
| AC-6 | Eight Demo B specs move to `test/playwright/e2e/dashboard/` because they exercise the Engine dashboard example; `FleetManagerNoTourWitnessNL` moved with the Institution receiver because intentional no-tour behavior remains valuable; the two tour E2Es and three tour/Mission Control unit specs retire because their deliberately omitted source has no product owner. |

## Deltas from ticket

The live disposition corrects the ticket's stale orphan count. Nine tests move within the Engine (the eight Demo B specs plus `TearOutMatrixRows4To7NL`), 132 received paths leave with the Institution product, six paths retire (five obsolete tour/Mission Control specs plus one unused screenshot), and shared Engine tests are retargeted to surviving Workstation or Colors hosts. The generated class hierarchy and portal discovery artifacts were refreshed; historical ticket-data mirrors remain untouched.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge:** `buildScripts/util/check-theme-surfaces.mjs` goes 657 → 217 lines and the workflow drops its three `agentos` path filters. The narrowing is right — a path filter matching nothing is trigger starvation, and renaming the job to **"Workstation Theme Guard"** makes it say what it checks, which is the correction I asked for on a differently-named job earlier today.

But the rewrite deletes this, and nothing replaces it:

> *"a surface registered in SURFACES but absent here is checked by `npm run check-theme-surfaces` and never by CI, so its coverage is decorative on exactly the tree it was added for. Registering a new surface means adding its three scss roots here."*

I checked whether that invariant survives: it does not — there is no `SURFACES` registry left, the script hardcodes the single Workstation surface at `:27-30`. So the comment is not a lost warning about a live rule; the rule went with the second surface. **The residue is that this was the only place in the tree recording that failure mode**, and it returns the moment a second theme surface is added — by someone reading a script with no registry and no note. One JSDoc line ("*a second surface must also be added to the workflow's path filters, or its coverage is decorative*") keeps the knowledge without keeping the machinery. Non-blocking.
